dct_description_sm:
Internal boundaries mark the limits of the parcels inside a jurisdictional area, for examples the internal boundaries of a First Nation Settlement Lands.

Details on specific feature types and their associated attributes can be found in the Integrated Cadastral Management Feature Catalogue, which is under development. For further information please contact the metadata responsible party. Associated information with respect to the Survey Records can be found at the following web site: https://www.nrcan.gc.ca/clss
